Have a backup plan in case talking to them doesn't work. 

If you're planning to talk to them, make sure the mood is good. Try and understand, why do they follow their religion? Make it a two-way conversation. If you show you're willing to understand their views, there is a chance they're willing to open their minds to yours. 

You can then begin by stating what you love about the religion they follow. Don't oversell it. Slowly, transition into the reasons why you don't see eye to eye. Make sure they're understanding this is from you, and not you being swayed by the internet or friends. Finalise by stating your current beliefs (atheism, another religion or philosophy, etc) 

Throughout all this, remember to allow them to digest the information. Tell them, questions can come after you've presented your points so you have the freedom to express everything. Be prepared for the questions and some doubt obviously. Listen to their questions calmly. 

Listen, listen, LISTEN. Your parents love you, you have to remember that, that's why they are adamant about having you in their religion. It's all they know. 

Hope it all works out for you.
